name: malicious-factory-users
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: leaves two unauthorized factory-tour accounts behind, one with a weak password and one with an empty password.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

# Keep the accounts reproducible if a bundle is deployed more than once.
if ! id tourguide >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd -m -s /bin/bash tourguide; fi
if ! id tempscout >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd -m -s /bin/bash tempscout; fi
printf '%s:%s\n' tourguide 'Chocolate123!' | chpasswd
# An empty password is intentional: it is the finding for the exercise.
usermod -p '' tempscout
